name: Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship
description: This Lucrehulk-class battleship participated in the Battle of Coruscant in 19 BBY. During the engagement, the Lucrehulk caught a Venator-class Star Destroyer in-between its docking arms. The captive Venator docked with the ship and offloaded teams of clone troopers whom tore through its corridors. During Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi's attempt to rescue the Supreme Chancellor, the clone soldiers had successfully captured the Lucrehulk.
